Pohyb ruské sabotážní skupiny Černí Rusové byl důvodem rozsáhlé operace polských bezpečnostních sil u hranic s ruskou Kaliningradskou oblastí. Uvedl to polský veřejnoprávní rozhlas Polskie Radio 24. Varšava na severovýchodě svého území zřídila speciální jednotku. Reagovala tak na varování rozvědky před možnými ruskými sabotážemi a vpády přes hranice.

Polští vojáci z 18. mechanizované divize hlídají polskou hranici s Běloruskem
Článek
„V reakci na hrozbu sabotáží posílily polské bezpečnostní složky ochranu hranic,“ vysvětlila stanice přesuny na polské straně hranice s ruskou Kaliningradskou oblastí. Velení polských bezpečnostních sil vyslalo do Podlaského a Varmijsko-mazurského vojvodství posily, včetně příslušníků polské speciální jednotky GROM, dalších příslušníků pohraniční stráže a policejních protiteroristických jednotek.
Podle polského premiéra Donalda Tuska se posily aktivovaly, když pohraničníci v noci na úterý zaznamenali…

orange alert

Radar surveillance systems operated by Romania's Ministry of National Defence detected two unmanned aerial vehicles that had entered the country's airspace without authorisation on the evening of 31 October.
Source: Romania's Ministry of National Defence , as reported by European Pravda
Details: Romania scrambled four F-16 fighter jets and an IAR-330 SOCAT helicopter to monitor the situation and manage the response after two unmanned aerial vehicles violated the country's airspace.

One of the two drones left the country's airspace, while the other was last spotted in the area between the counties of Vaslui and Bacău.
No drone crashes were reported.

Image source, EPA
Image caption, Bomb squads have searched many schools but no devices have been found
By Paulin Kola
Published
1 hour ago
Schools across Italy have received bomb threats for the second day in a row, sparking fresh panic and evacuations.
Some 1,800 schools, from Milan in the north to Sicily in the south, reported receiving a similar threat to one that created chaos in Italy on Wednesday - even though no devices have been found anywhere.
The Italian government has advised schools that "in the absence of concrete evidence beyond the simple receipt of a mass email indicating a danger, buildings must not not be evacuated".
Schools in Scotland and Northern Ireland received threats on Wednesday, too. It is unclear whether the incidents are connected.
On Thursday morning, a bomb alert at a Calais rail station delayed international and national train services in northern France.
The latest incidents follow a series of bomb hoaxes last week against airports and airlines in a number of European countries.

Af

En række italienske skoler er igen i dag blevet evakueret efter at have modtaget mails med bombetrusler.
Det skriver det italienske nyhedsbureau Ansa.
Den italienske regering har netop meddelt, at omkring 1.800 italienske skoler i dag har modtaget bombetrusler. 
Truslerne er sendt til skoler over hele landet - blandt andet til skoler i regionerne Ligurien, Umbrien og i hovedstaden Rom.
Det er anden dag i streg, at italienske skoler modtager bombetrusler. 
I går modtog skoler i Irland, Nordirland og Skotland også bombetrusler. I alle tre lande opfattede politiets mailsene som fupnumre, men valgte alligevel at evakuere en del skoler.

A senior Russian military officer was killed when an explosive device detonated under his vehicle in a southern suburb of St. Petersburg, investigators said Thursday.
The explosion occurred at around 7:00 a.m. local time in the city’s Pushkinsky district, according to law enforcement and media reports .
The victim was a colonel serving in the Russian Aerospace Forces’ 6th Guards Air and Air Defense Forces Army, according to sources cited by the local broadcaster 78.ru. His name was not disclosed.

Traffic on Kolpinskoye Highway near the blast site has been shut down.
A car carrying a lieutenant colonel and his wife exploded on Kolpinskoye Highway on August 27. The serviceman died. His wife survived. An explosive device had been attached to the underside of the car. Fontanka, a St. Petersburg-based news outlet, citing sources, reported that a 24-year-old Russian woman who left for Turkey after the blast is suspected of planting the bomb in the car. Ukraine’s armed forces is carrying out a massive, hours-long drone attack on Omsk.
Omsk Governor Vitaliy Khotsenko declared a drone threat alert on November 11 at 12:40 p.m. Moscow time. It remained in effect as of 8:10 p.m. Moscow time. Six hours into the attack, Khotsenko urged residents to stay indoors.
Amid the attack, authorities in Omsk have canceled entertainment and sports events planned for November 11: theater and ballet performances, the Sila Sibiri “Power of Siberia” figure skating Grand Prix, as well as the opening of the Dostoevsky.Omsk theater festival.
The targets and aftermath of the attack remain unconfirmed. Citing eyewitnesses, local Telegram channels reported that a fire broke out at the Omsk oil refinery and that a power plant may also have been damaged.
It is the second time since the war in Ukraine began that authorities have also declared a drone threat…

An Tausenden Schulen in Italien sind per E-Mail Bombendrohungen eingegangen. Auch in Großbritannien gibt es ähnliche Fälle. Die Behörden gehen von Falschmeldungen aus. Wer hinter den Drohungen steckt, ist unklar.
Etwa 6.000 Schulen in Italien haben E-Mails mit Bombendrohungen erhalten. Die Regierung gab inzwischen Entwarnung: Italiens Ministerpräsidentin Giorgia Meloni betonte, nach den bisher durchgeführten Überprüfungen gebe es keinerlei Hinweise auf eine konkrete Gefahr. Vorsorglich waren nach Regierungsangaben dennoch mindestens 300 Schulen evakuiert worden.
Von den Behörden gab es zunächst keine Angaben zu möglichen Hintergründen der Bombendrohungen. Meloni schrieb auf Facebook von einer "Strategie, die darauf abzielt, Beunruhigung und Sorge zu schüren". Sie kündigte eine umfassende Untersuchung der Vorfälle an und berief eine Krisensitzung der Regierung ein.

Trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi between Russia, Ukraine and the US aimed at ending the war in Ukraine have concluded after a second day.
Although the American side said they saw "some openings", there was no hint of any breakthroughs to end the nearly five year-long war sparked by Russia's invasion.
Davyd Arakhamia from Ukraine's negotiating team said that this round of talks - the first since February - "was one of the hardest."

Illegal border crossers in Ludza region, November 10th, 2026
Today, 15:08
Crime
Authors:
LSM English (Latvian Public Media)
On Tuesday, November 10th, border guards in Ludza region detained a Belarusian citizen who had illegally crossed the state border.
While checking the information received, border guards in Zaļesje parish stopped a small Škoda car driven by a Belarusian citizen. Upon checking the vehicle, seven persons without valid visas or residence permits, who had previously illegally crossed the Belarusian-Latvian border, were found in its interior and luggage compartment. A photograph showed people crammed into the back of the car with a blanket over their heads.
Criminal proceedings have been initiated against the carrier under Section 285, Part 3.1 of the Criminal Law for the illegal movement of persons across the state border.

shrnuti: Russian Telegram channels covering military aviation reported that pilots were killed in a Ukrainian drone attack on the Leningrad region.

Russian pro-war military bloggers report pilots killed during Ukrainian drone attack on Leningrad region
November 11, 2026, 12:45 pm
Source: Meduza
Russian Telegram channels covering military aviation reported that pilots were killed in a Ukrainian drone attack on the Leningrad region.
The news appeared on the Fighterbomber channel, run by Z-blogger Ilya Tumanov. “Today’s defense of the skies over St. Petersburg from the drone attack cost us very dearly. Very, very dearly,” he wrote, without giving any details.
The Telegram channel Na predele “On the Edge” also reported the pilots’ deaths without specifying the circumstances. The post included a photo of a Ka-52 “Alligator” helicopter.
Russian authorities have officially said only that a Ukrainian drone attack on Ust-Luga, in the Kingisepp district, injured three port workers.

Some 300 schools across Italy have received bomb threats, according to Education Minister Giuseppe Valditara, who described the incidents as probably a "cyber-attack, not a genuine risk".
Valditara told Italian TV that there was a clear strategy behind the rash of threats in Italy and elsewhere in Europe which had targeted flights, supermarkets and even hospitals.
The emails were sent to schools in Rome, Naples, Vicenza, Florence, Pisa, Trieste and many other Italian cities, and a number of buildings were evacuated as a precaution.
Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has called a meeting of top ministers and intelligence chiefs.
Meloni said the government was monitoring closely the "numerous reports of bomb threats at educational institutions" although checks so far had not indicated any evidence of "concrete danger".

RTL Today
AFP
Hundreds of schools across Italy were evacuated on Wednesday after receiving bomb threats by email, prompting police investigations into the source of the messages.
Published: 11.11.26 12:55 , Update: 11.11.26 12:57
© MATTEO DELLA TORRE/NurPhoto via AFP
Schools were evacuated across Italy on Wednesday following a series of hoax bomb threats, but Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni said there was no "concrete danger".
The exact number of schools affected remains unclear, as the emails were sent to hundreds of institutions, with individual schools deciding whether to evacuate following advice from local police, according to media sources.
Authorities are investigating the origin of the messages, although police have not confirmed the email address from which they were sent.
This is a developing story and more information will follow.

Bombendrohung: Rund 300 Schulen in Italien betroffen
11.11.2026 12.50
Online seit heute, 12.50 Uhr
Eine anonyme Bombendrohung hat heute an rund 300 Schulen in Italien Alarm ausgelöst. Betroffen waren Bildungseinrichtungen in mehreren Städten. Schüler und Schulpersonal wurden vorsorglich evakuiert. Polizeikräfte durchsuchten die Gebäude nach möglichen Sprengsätzen.
Besonders viele Schulen waren in Rom betroffen. Die Schulleitungen verständigten die Polizei, die zur Räumung der Gebäude riet. Der Absender der Droh-E-Mails gab sich Medienberichten zufolge als Vertreter einer terroristischen Organisation aus.
Krisensitzung einberufen
Die italienische Regierung reagierte mit einer kurzfristig einberufenen Krisensitzung unter der Leitung von Ministerpräsidentin Giorgia Meloni. Der italienische Verteidigungsminister Guido Crosetto verurteilte die Bombendrohungen. Sie seien Teil einer „Strategie, Angst und Besorgnis zu verbreiten“.
Die Sicherheitskräfte seien gerade damit beschäftigt, ernst zu nehmende Drohungen von den Taten profilierungssüchtiger Menschen zu unterscheiden, sagte der Minister. Solche Fälle würden leider…

November 11, 2026, 9:22 am
Source: Meduza
Russia’s FSB arrested two Polish citizens in the Kaliningrad region on espionage charges, its Public Relations Center said.
A Polish intelligence “network of agents” had been operating in the region, the FSB said.
It said they collected and passed on information about Russian military personnel and Defense Ministry facilities, as well as “information about the socio-economic situation, and migration and social policy” in the region.
The FSB also issued official warnings against espionage and treason to seven more Polish citizens and three Russian citizens who had contact with Polish intelligence services. The seven Poles were barred from entering Russia “for an extended period.”
The FSB made the announcement on Poland’s Independence Day, which falls on November 11.

Ukrainian drones strike port in Russia’s Leningrad region, sparking fire
November 11, 2026, 8:13 am
Source: Alexander Drozdenko
Ukrainian drones attacked Russia’s Leningrad region overnight on November 11, and 150 of them were shot down over the region, Governor Alexander Drozdenko said.
He said the attack targeted the port zone of Ust-Luga, in the Kingisepp district. Several drones hit the area, sparking a fire and injuring three port workers. A transformer substation in Ust-Luga also experienced an emergency shutdown.
The drone attack forced the closure of Pulkovo Airport. Passenger planes flying to St. Petersburg from Istanbul and Hurghada landed in Helsinki instead. By morning, 30 outbound flights from Pulkovo were delayed .
Smolensk region also came under drone attack, and air defenses shot down 37 drones, said the region’s governor, Vasily Anokhin. In the city of Yartsevo, “debris” hit a multi-story building, sparking a fire. Two people died.
Videos posted online show an apartment on fire inside a residential building.

FBI Director Kash Patel called the arrest “important” and said it “involves allegations of espionage, which is of the utmost concern to the United States and our allies.”
Noting the investigation is ongoing, he added that the FBI “has no tolerance for anyone who breaks their oath to the United States and whose actions endanger our national security and that of our partners.”

November 10, 2026, 5:09 pm
Source: Internal Security Agency of Poland (ABW)
Two Ukrainian citizens, ages 24 and 25, have been arrested in Poland on suspicion of espionage and sabotage on behalf of Russian intelligence services, said Tomasz Siemoniak, the Polish minister who coordinates the country’s intelligence services.
Investigators allege that the two photographed critical infrastructure and military facilities in Poland and set cars on fire. They replaced vehicle license plates with plates from Ukrainian military vehicles to deflect suspicion. They were paid for these tasks, including in cryptocurrency.
Poland’s Internal Security Agency said both suspects have been ordered held in custody for three months. They face sentences ranging from 10 years to life in prison, the agency said.

A freight train derailed in northwestern Russia’s Arkhangelsk region following the collapse of a railroad bridge, Russian Railways and local officials said Tuesday, causing disruptions to passenger rail service along the affected track.
Arkhangelsk region Governor Alexander Tsybulsky said the accident took place around 5:10 a.m. Moscow time. He said part of a railroad bridge over the Viled River collapsed, leading several freight cars to derail.
Tsybulsky said officials were coordinating an emergency response effort. No one was injured in the accident.
At least eight long-distance passenger trains traveling between major cities — including Moscow and St. Petersburg — were left stranded following the derailment.

titulek: French wartime resistance heroine Solange Alexandre dies aged 104
titulekPuvodni: French wartime resistance heroine Solange Alexandre dies aged 104
shrnuti: With 30 men under her orders, she organised sabotage operations, sheltered Allied airmen and joined the fight against the occupying German forces.

vyrez.text:
French wartime resistance heroine Solange Alexandre dies aged 104 - BBC News
Image source, Site Pôle Jean Moulin
Image caption, Solange Alexandre twice turned down the Légion d'Honneur before relenting in 2024
By Hugh Schofield in Paris
Published
38 minutes ago
One of France's last Resistance heroes from World War Two has died at the age of 104. Solange Alexandre was also a rare woman who, with her future husband, created and commanded her own unit of anti-German fighters.
After serving as a Resistance courier from 1941, three years later she founded the Pas-de-Boeuf network near the town of Ruillé-sur-Loir.
With some 30 men under her orders, she organised sabotage operations, sheltered Allied airmen and, after the Allied landings in Normandy on D-Day in 1944, joined the fight against the occupying German forces.
President Emmanuel Macron was among many to pay tribute to Alexandre, after her death was announced at a nursing home in Le Mans.
"She said she only ever did her duty. But her duty was our freedom. France will never forget. Thank you," Macron posted on social media.

Skip to main content
Advertisement
PARIS — French Minister of Foreign Affairs Jean-Noël Barrot said Iran was behind the recent series of “unprecedented” cyberattacks on refrigerators in several major supermarket chains in the country last month.
“Thanks to the outstanding work of the government departments, I am able to confirm that responsibility for this attack lies with the Iranian Revolutionary Guards,” Barrot told reporters Monday at a G7 meeting in Paris. “We will impose sanctions at European level against those responsible.”
Barrot said that 700 food distribution sites in France were impacted in the cyberattack. French prosecutors said shortly after that they were opening an investigation into the hacks.
Though Barrot was only referring to the incidents reported in France, grocery stores across Europe and even French blood banks have been targeted by hackers in recent days. Cyber experts had previously raised concerns that the attacks may have been part of Russia’s ongoing hybrid warfare against Europe, though the Kremlin has denied any involvement.

Ukrainian drones struck the Leningrad region overnight on November 9, and 113 of them were shot down, Governor Alexander Drozdenko said.
Drozdenko said “there have been instances of drone hits” in an industrial zone in Kirishi. He said “fragments” also hit an apartment in Kirishi and the roof of an apartment building in Vsevolozhsk, without providing further details.
Update. Drozdenko later confirmed that drones struck an oil refinery in Kirishi, where a fire broke out. In Vsevolozhsk, a woman died after “falling of debris” from a drone hit the roof of a house. Astra, an independent Telegram channel, analyzed videos from Kirishi and reported that the Kirishinefteorgsintez oil refinery — a Surgutneftegas subsidiary and one of the largest refineries in Russia — was on fire.
Ukrainian monitoring channels also reported the fire at the Kirishi plant.

Estonian Interior Minister Igor Taro has said that Russian acts of aggression in Europe should be regarded as state terrorism rather than hybrid incidents.

Pro relaxaci po lyžování jsou ideální termální lázně v Bad Kleinkirchheimu, kde lze kombinovat sport s lenošením v teplé vodě a výhledem na zasněžené hory.

On 9th November 2026, Minister of Foreign Affairs Baiba Braže will be in the New York (USA) to take part in an emergency meeting of the UN Security Council (UNSC) on the subject of Ukraine.
The meeting will take place under the agenda item ‘Maintenance of peace and security in Ukraine’.
At Ukraine’s request, and with the support of Denmark, France, Greece and the United Kingdom, Latvia called for the emergency meeting in response to Russia’s intensified attacks on Ukrainian civilians and critical civilian infrastructure, including the strikes on 2 November in Komyshuvakha, in the Zaporizhzhia region, where more than 50 people were killed in attacks on a humanitarian aid distribution point and a civilian shelter, followed by further strikes that also claimed the lives of rescue workers who had arrived at the scene.

titulekPuvodni: Russia attacks Ukraine with 317 drones, 276 UAVs downed
shrnuti: Russia launched hundreds of attack drones, with strikes recorded at 31 locations and debris from UAVs falling at nine others.

Ukrainian air defence destroys 276 out of 317 Russian drones in overnight attack | Ukrainska Pravda
A downed drone. Stock photo: State Border Guard Service of Ukraine on Telegram
Russian forces have attacked Ukraine with 317 Shahed (105 jet-powered) and Gerbera attack drones, S-8000 Banderol/Dan-T drone- and air-launched cruise missiles and Parody decoy UAVs since the evening of 8 November. Air defence forces have destroyed 276 drones, although some strikes have been recorded.
Source: Ukraine's Air Force
Quote: "As of 08:00, [Ukrainian] air defence forces had destroyed or jammed 271 Shaheds (81 jet-powered), S-8000 Banderols/Dan-Ts, Gerberas and other types of drones. Several attack drones remain airborne, and combat operations are ongoing."
Advertisement:





Details: Hits by drones have been recorded at 31 locations and the fall of downed UAVs (debris) at nine locations.
Aircraft, anti-aircraft missile units, electronic warfare assets, unmanned systems units and mobile fire groups from Ukraine's defence forces have been involved in repelling the attack.
